title: clystere pipeline parameters
description: Nextflow pipeline for antiSMASH + BiG-SCAPE biosynthetic gene cluster analysis

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input and save output data.

input.description: Path to samplesheet CSV with columns: sample, genome[, annotation].
input.help_text: CSV file with a header row. Required columns: `sample` (unique identifier) and `genome` (path to a GenBank/EMBL/FASTA file). Optional column: `annotation` (path to a GFF3 annotation file).

outdir.description: Directory where pipeline results will be published.

antismash_db.description: Path to an antiSMASH database directory. Downloaded automatically when absent or empty.

antismash_taxon.description: Taxonomic scope for antiSMASH detection rules.

antismash_genefinding_tool.description: Gene-finding tool used when no annotation is provided.

antismash_minlength.description: Minimum sequence length (bp) for a record to be analysed.

antismash_limit.description: Maximum number of records to analyse per file. Set to -1 to disable.

antismash_minimal.description: Run antiSMASH in minimal mode. Individual modules can then be re-enabled selectively.

antismash_extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments appended verbatim to the antiSMASH invocation.

antismash_accept_failure.description: Continue the pipeline if antiSMASH fails for a sample instead of aborting.

antismash_reuse_results.description: Pass `--reuse-results` to antiSMASH to reuse a previous output directory.

antismash_modules_options.title: antiSMASH — analysis modules
antismash_modules_options.description: Enable or disable individual antiSMASH analysis modules. All are disabled by default when running in minimal mode.

antismash_fullhmmer.description: Run a full-genome Pfam HMM scan (`--fullhmmer`).

antismash_cassis.description: Run CASSIS cluster border prediction (`--cassis`). Requires a genome with gene annotation.

antismash_clusterhmmer.description: Run Pfam HMM scan limited to cluster regions (`--clusterhmmer`).

antismash_pfam2go.description: Map Pfam annotations to Gene Ontology terms (`--pfam2go`).

antismash_rre.description: Run RRE-Finder for RiPP recognition element detection (`--rre`).

antismash_smcog_trees.description: Generate phylogenetic trees for secondary metabolite COGs (`--smcog-trees`).

antismash_fullhmmer_pfamdb_version.description: Pfam database version to use with `--fullhmmer`.

antismash_clusterhmmer_pfamdb_version.description: Pfam database version to use with `--clusterhmmer`.

antismash_rre_minlength.description: Minimum amino acid length for RRE-Finder candidates.

antismash_tfbs_range.description: Upstream search range (bp) for TFBS detection.

antismash_tta_threshold.description: GC content threshold for TTA codon detection.

antismash_clusterblast_options.title: antiSMASH — cluster comparison
antismash_clusterblast_options.description: Options for cluster comparison and annotation modules (ClusterBlast, MIBiG).

antismash_cc_mibig.description: Compare clusters against the MIBiG reference database (`--cc-mibig`).

antismash_cc_custom_dbs.description: Comma-separated paths to custom ClusterCompare database config files (`--cc-custom-dbs`).

antismash_cb_knownclusters.description: Run KnownClusterBlast against MIBiG (`--cb-knownclusters`). Results are included in the tabulation summary when enabled.

antismash_cb_nclusters.description: Number of top ClusterBlast hits to report (default: 10).

antismash_cb_min_homology_scale.description: Minimum homology scale for ClusterBlast hits (0.0–1.0).

antismash_hmmdetection_options.title: antiSMASH — HMM detection
antismash_hmmdetection_options.description: Options controlling HMM-based BGC detection sensitivity.

antismash_hmmdetection_strictness.description: Strictness level for HMM-based rule detection.

antismash_hmmdetection_fungal_cutoff_mul.description: Multiplier applied to HMM cutoff scores for fungal genomes.

antismash_hmmdetection_fungal_neighbourh.description: Multiplier applied to neighbourhood size for fungal genomes.

antismash_hmmdetection_limit_to_rule_nam.description: Comma-separated list of rule names to restrict detection to.

antismash_hmmdetection_limit_to_rule_cat.description: Comma-separated list of rule categories to restrict detection to.

antismash_zip_output.description: Archive the antiSMASH output directory as a zip file.

antismash_summary_gbk.description: Write a summary GenBank file of all detected regions.

antismash_region_gbks.description: Write individual GenBank files for each detected region.

antismash_allow_long_headers.description: Allow header lines longer than 80 characters in output files.

antismash_sideload.description: Comma-separated paths to JSON sideload files (`--sideload`).

antismash_sideload_simple.description: Sideload a simple region by coordinates, e.g. `ACCESSION:START-END` (`--sideload-simple`).

antismash_sideload_by_cds.description: Comma-separated locus tags to sideload as a region (`--sideload-by-cds`).

bigscape_options.title: BiG-SCAPE options
bigscape_options.description: Options for BiG-SCAPE gene cluster family (GCF) analysis.

run_bigscape.description: Run BiG-SCAPE on the antiSMASH output.

bigscape_pfam_path.description: Path to `Pfam-A.hmm`. Resolved automatically from `--antismash_db` when absent.

bigscape_gcf_cutoffs.description: Space-separated list of GCF distance cutoffs passed to `--gcf-cutoffs`.

bigscape_mix.description: Analyse all BGC classes together in a single network (`--mix`).

bigscape_include_singletons.description: Include singleton BGCs (those that form no GCF) in the output (`--include-singletons`).

bigscape_extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments appended verbatim to the BiG-SCAPE invocation.

bigscape_zip_output.description: Archive the BiG-SCAPE output directory as a `.tar.gz` file.

tabulation_options.title: Tabulation options
tabulation_options.description: Options for summary table generation across all antiSMASH results.

run_tabulation.description: Generate per-region and per-genome BGC count summary tables.

count_per_contig.description: Report BGC counts per contig rather than aggregated per genome assembly.

split_hybrids.description: Count each product type in hybrid BGCs separately. The `total_count` column is unaffected.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Pipeline-level options that are not specific to any analysis step.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to `--outdir`.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: Use `copy` for portability. `symlink` saves disk space but breaks when the work directory is cleaned.

monochrome_logs.description: Disable ANSI colour codes in log output.

help.description: Display the help message and exit.

version.description: Display the pipeline version and exit.
